solution_summary: Riachuelo modernized its analytics estate on Power BI, Power Platform, Azure Databricks, moving from fragmented legacy tooling to a governed cloud data platform. Operational, enterprise, or sensor data is ingested into a shared cloud store and transformed with Azure engineering services so teams can work from one current source of truth. Power BI then serves dashboards, self-service exploration, and decision support to business users at scale. It also connects with surrounding systems such as CRM and ERP systems, which lets the new Azure-based workflow fit into existing operations rather than standing apart from them. Finally, visualization of all this data processing is performed by Power BI , Microsoft's Business Intelligence service, and management of its catalog and data glossary by Azure Purview , a data governance service that classifies and promotes automated management.
